overview: Index (1934-36) tracks Holmes's inquiries on Japanese artificial wool, consular reports and fiber/yarn/cloth samples from Kobe and Tokyo, Agriculture and Commerce interest, and concern over a Daily News Record article apparently leaked from a nonpublic consular report, with denied requests for copies.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: Manufacture of Artificial Wool in Japan
subfiles.from: U.S. Department of State, compiler unidentified
subfiles.about: A chronological index summarizes correspondence, consular reports, sample transfers, and publication inquiries concerning Japanese artificial wool and staple fiber.
subfiles.summary: Index traces Holmes's 1934 request on Japanese staple fiber, consular reporting and sample circulation from Tokyo, Kobe, and Nagoya, a Daily News Record article apparently drawn from the report, and denied requests for copies, referred to Commerce.

interest: Tracks 1934-36 State Department gathering of Japanese staple-fiber samples and reports, and press leak concerns.
